description: This file contains shell script code used for testing Git hooks and push operations involving refs, including setup, pushing with mixed refs, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, with a description explaining its purpose.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail, used to test failure scenarios.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats output and saves expected results for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares the current refs in a repository against expected refs.
